updated_description_fields.description: Compares the IAM role creation date and AWS RoleLastUsed date with a 60-day window before capture. New roles do not fail for missing use. Recorded use must fall within the role lifetime. Old roles without recorded use stay unresolved, because AWS tracking cannot prove inactivity.
evaluated: RoleName, RoleId and role ARN/account consistency
RoleLastUsed.LastUsedDate with current role lifetime and future-date validation
native field coverage; null or missing usage remains unresolved for an old role
updated_description_fields.pass_when: The role was created within 60 days or its valid recorded AWS use is within 60 days of capture.
updated_description_fields.fail_when: The current role is older than 60 days and its valid recorded AWS use is more than 60 days before capture.

reason: Correct creation-age false positives, future/pre-creation timestamps and ambiguous empty usage. Retain the original signed source, ID and formal mappings; current criteria use an exact captured UTC 60-day interval.
